name: Mato Grosso Arára
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

sources.citation: D'Angelis, Wilmar da Rocha. 2010. Arara do Rio Branco (MT), tb Arara do Aripuanã: tentativa de estabelecer algumas raízes, morfemas e relações semânticas. Ms., Unicamp, 7 pp. [= Glottolog 138962 'Alguns Radicais e Morfemas Arara Rio Branco MT']
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No statement. Thematic wordlist (~200 items) in IPA with primary stress marked (ˈ, rendered " in the text layer) and occasional secondary stress (ˌ, rendered Æ); stress falls on the final syllable in the large majority of polysyllables ([nuka"pi] 'olhos', [ba"ja] 'menino', [a|e"ka] 'fogo', [mu|utu"pai] 'galho', [beÆkoku"pe] 'onça preta'), with a few non-final forms (["beko] 'onça', ["baÆi0] 'flecha'). Transcription only, no rule stated.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Silent on stress placement. The phonology section (pp. 4-5) covers the consonant and vowel charts, prenasalised/nasal series, liquids, and syllable structure (CCVC max, V min). The only mention of accent is that the onset-cluster variants ([b|ip"ta] ~ [bi|ip"ta]) may relate 'à seqüência de vogais iguais e à velocidade de fala e posição acentual' (p. 5).
